basic_info.description:
This charming 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo in a secure gated community offers modern living. Located on floor 3, the private balcony overlooks both the courtyard below as well as provides an idyllic view of the Bayview Park. Within the unit, enjoy the open-concept layout, walk in closets, in-unit washer/dryer, and community amenities like a dog-friendly grassy area, gym and BBQ space. 

Conveniently located near bay trails, Highway 101, and free shuttles to CalTrain and BART, this home makes commuting a breeze. Local dining gems like Mission Blue and Creative Ideas add to the vibrant neighborhood.

Don't miss this move-in-ready urban retreat!
